approved: Written by a model from the explanatory memorandum; not the record
This bill would take money from the Consolidated Revenue Fund for government spending that is not part of its everyday running costs.
It would work alongside a separate bill for ordinary annual services, as required by the Constitution, to provide extra funding for the 2023-24 financial year.
The explanatory memorandum does not specify the total amount of money to be appropriated or list the individual programs funded.
Proposes additional appropriations from the Consolidated Revenue Fund for non-ordinary annual services.
Supplements earlier annual appropriations from the 2023-24 financial year.
Responds to government decisions made after the 2023-24 Mid-Year Economic and Fiscal Outlook.
The Australian Government and its agencies that receive the additional funding.
